parsed.rationale: All four records are type-alias-objects named `SequentialMockSession` nested inside different test-suite types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`) within the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`. Although the context flags do not carry `is_test=true` (the pipeline appears to have mis-classified them), the file path `Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`, the enclosing type names ending in `Tests`, and the `SequentialMockSession` naming convention all unambiguously identify these as test-fixture type aliases. The `fields_or_signature` list is empty for every record, so there is no shared implementation body to consolidate. Merging them into a single shared alias would couple the three independent test suites and obscure which mock session belongs to which service under test.
